name: 48033 · Southfield, MI
findings: ZIP 48033 (Southfield) has 185 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48033 (Southfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48033 (Southfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
